findings.title: Model router call log file is missing

evidence.observation: Model router call log does not exist at /opt/starship-endeavour/core/model-router/call_log.jsonl despite router being reachable

proposed_action.description: Ensure the model router service creates and logs model requests to call_log.jsonl with proper filesystem permissions

findings.expected_benefit: Enables telemetry, latency tracking, and failure analysis for local and cloud LLM invocations

findings.title: Direct LLM API invocations bypass centralized model router in emergency alert

evidence.observation: Direct calls to call_gemini and call_mistral using raw environment API keys instead of dispatching through the model router

proposed_action.description: Update emergency alert LLM requests to use the centralized model router client interface

findings.expected_benefit: Maintains unified governance, rate limiting, fallback routing, and observability across all LLM queries
findings.policy_decision_rationale: Category: router_bypass; Evidence strength: conclusive; Confidence: 0.90; Risk: high; Automation: needs_signoff; Category reason: Router bypasses must be corrected by design review
